hebrewText: כִּ֣י מַרְבִּ֣ית הָ/עָ֡ם רַ֠בַּת מֵֽ/אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה יִשָּׂשכָ֤ר וּ/זְבֻלוּן֙ לֹ֣א הִטֶּהָ֔רוּ כִּֽי אָכְל֥וּ אֶת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בְּ/לֹ֣א כַ/כָּת֑וּב כִּי֩ הִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֥ה הַ/טּ֖וֹב יְכַפֵּ֥ר בְּעַֽד

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
tokens.kjv: Ephraim, Ephraimites.

tokens.bdb: Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
tokens.kjv: Manasseh.

tokens.bdb: Jissaskar, a son of Jacob
tokens.kjv: Issachar.

tokens.bdb: Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe
tokens.kjv: Zebulun.

tokens.bdb: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
tokens.kjv: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, [idiom] freely, [idiom] in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, [idiom] quite.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim)
tokens.kjv: passover (offering).

tokens.bdb: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray
tokens.kjv: intreat, judge(-ment), (make) pray(-er, -ing), make supplication.

tokens.bdb: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
tokens.kjv: Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169 (יְחִזְקִיָּה).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).

tokens.bdb: to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel
tokens.kjv: appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).
